evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: What date did you say you're gonna be moving? / Can you give me the zip code we're starting at and the zip code we're going to. / Are we moving out of a house or an apartment? / The square feet, like the size of your condo.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_branch_offered: Yes, if you can take videos, so I can text you a link where you can upload photos and videos of your condo and then we can get you an accurate estimate.
evidence_quotes.packing_services: Definitely we can also do the packing.
evidence_quotes.no_quid_pro_quo: Rep jumps directly into probing (zip code, property type) without framing the call duration, promise of dependable quote, or waiting for customer agreement.
evidence_quotes.no_their_agenda: Rep never asked 'What are your biggest concerns about this move?' or equivalent before or during probing.

top_strength: Rep correctly identified a large move (900 sq ft condo with full packing needed) and properly routed to virtual walkthrough with photo/video intake, capturing all four discovery basics before pivoting.
coaching_note: Section 1: Always open with the quid pro quo (10–15 minute call, dependable quote, waiting for yes) before jumping into probing—it frames the conversation and sets expectations. Section 2: Ask 'What are your biggest concerns about this move?' early, before logistics details, to surface agenda and build trust.
booking_note: Customer agreed to upload photos/videos for an estimate first: 'I'll upload the photos and then we'll take it from there.' No move date was locked in yet, pending the walkthrough assessment.
